name: Borsodnádasd (Hungary)
description: A vertical white banner charged at the centre with the town arms of Borsodnádasd: a blue and red shield with crossed hammers and reeds, with a helm, a yellow crest and red and blue mantling, above a scroll.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Borsodnádasd arms with helm, crest, mantling and scroll
